calls.name: integer
calls.why: a plain integer: trailing spaces trimmed, digits right-aligned into EPSPARM-NUMBER, binary number = 123.00

calls.name: leading-spaces
calls.why: leading spaces are skipped by the second PERFORM UNTIL

calls.name: comma-and-decimal
calls.why: a comma is skipped by A001; the fraction digits go left-aligned into EPSPARM-DECIMAL

calls.name: decimal-only
calls.why: no integer part: EPSPARM-NUMBER stays zero, binary = 0.50

calls.name: trailing-point
calls.why: a point with nothing after it: decimal zero

calls.name: too-many-points
calls.why: a second '.' -> STATIC-ERROR-TABLE(3) 'TOO MANY DEICMAL POINTS'; no binary number

calls.name: embedded-space
calls.why: a space inside the number -> error 2 'SPACES IN NUMBER'

calls.name: all-spaces
calls.why: nothing to read: END-SPACE stays 0 -> error 1 'NO NUMBER PRESENT'

calls.name: thirteen-digits
calls.why: the field's whole width: thirteen digits

calls.name: max-length-limits
calls.why: EPSPARM-MAX-LENGTH 05: only the first five characters are read (12345)

calls.name: max-length-too-big
calls.why: a maximum above the field's 13 is clamped to 13

calls.name: max-length-zero
calls.why: a zero maximum reads nothing -> error 1

calls.name: long-fraction
calls.why: twelve fraction digits, then '13' as the maximum length: EPSPARM-DECIMAL takes them left-aligned

notes: IBM DBB MortgageApplication's number validator, CALLed by EPSCMORT. Its one USING item is the 129-byte EPS-NUMBER-VALIDATION group (copybook EPSNBRPM): EPSPARM-VALIDATE-DATA X(13) and EPSPARM-MAX-LENGTH 99 in; EPSPARM-NUMBER 9(13), EPSPARM-DECIMAL V9(13), EPSPARM-BINARY-NUMBER 9(9)V99 COMP and EPSPARM-RETURN-ERROR X(80) out. Each call passes the 15 input characters; the rest of the group starts as spaces and is set by the program.
